title: AutoPay and the Rate Cut on a PracticePay Patient Financing Reset
content:
**AutoPay on a reset plan.** AutoPay can be turned on or off at any time and carries no rate discount, except that a payment reset under the reset schedule counts the AutoPay debits already credited on the plan as that schedule sets.

**Rule.** The AutoPay-record rate cut of a PracticePay Patient Financing payment reset counts the AutoPay debits credited on the plan that did not come back: 5 or more gives 0.5 percentage points, 3 up to one below 5 gives 0.25 percentage points, and fewer gives 0.

| AutoPay debits credited on the plan that did not come back | Rate cut (percentage points) |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 0.5 |
| 3 or 4 | 0.25 |
| 0, 1 or 2 | 0 |

*Hypothetical.* Seven AutoPay debits credited, none of which came back: 7 count, a cut of 0.5. Two AutoPay debits credited: a cut of 0.
